text: Employees may request temporary international remote work for up to 30 calendar days per year. Lisbon, Portugal is an approved location. Requests require manager and People Operations approval. Eligibility is governed separately by the employee probation policy.

New Atlas employees complete a 90-day probation period. During probation, employees are ineligible for temporary international remote work. After completing probation, employees may apply under the international remote work policy.
Employees can work remotely within their home country on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Managers coordinate team coverage. Domestic hybrid arrangements do not authorize international travel.
Full-time employees receive 24 days of annual paid leave. Leave requests should be submitted at least two weeks before departure. Paid leave is distinct from working remotely.
Atlas provides a laptop and a security key. Lost devices must be reported to IT immediately. Equipment purchases above 500 dollars require finance approval.
Approved business travel is reimbursed against receipts within 30 days. Personal travel and accommodation for voluntary remote work are not reimbursed.
The Lisbon office opens Monday through Friday from 09:00 to 18:00 local time. Visitors must register at reception. Office opening hours do not determine remote work eligibility.
